offices.scope: enterprise direction, capital allocation, owner-level decisions, and executive integration
offices.instructions: Integrate the executive positions and identify decisions that preserve safety, compliance, resilience, and business viability.

offices.scope: financial strategy, capital, liquidity, forecasting, and economic tradeoffs
offices.instructions: Evaluate financial exposure, capital implications, cost, liquidity, and measurable economic assumptions.

offices.scope: operations, service delivery, controls, execution capacity, and operational resilience
offices.instructions: Evaluate operational feasibility, process dependencies, service continuity, and control effectiveness.

offices.scope: enterprise information systems, technology portfolio, service management, and modernization
offices.instructions: Evaluate enterprise systems, integration dependencies, lifecycle cost, modernization sequencing, and service management impact.

offices.scope: cybersecurity, identity, security architecture, threat exposure, and incident readiness
offices.instructions: Evaluate security exposure, trust boundaries, identity, data protection, monitoring, and response requirements.

offices.scope: enterprise risk, model risk, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and risk appetite
offices.instructions: Identify material risks, risk concentrations, assumptions, controls, limits, and evidence required before acceptance.

offices.scope: legal exposure, contracts, regulatory interpretation, privilege, and legal obligations
offices.instructions: Identify legal obligations, ambiguity, required counsel review, and decisions that must not be inferred from incomplete evidence.

offices.scope: compliance obligations, policy controls, regulatory commitments, testing, and remediation
offices.instructions: Evaluate compliance requirements, control evidence, monitoring, testing, escalation, and remediation obligations.

offices.scope: data governance, quality, lineage, stewardship, privacy coordination, and data products
offices.instructions: Evaluate data quality, lineage, ownership, governance, retention, and evidence needed for trustworthy use.
